next.reason: 1985 GR25: 'The minimum and maximum record sizes for a file are established at the time the file is created and must not subsequently be changed.' The 2023 statement is uncatalogued prose (9.1.6: fixed file attributes 'cannot be changed throughout the lifetime of the file', listing the minimum and maximum record size). Catalogued parts: §2023:9.1.13.2 GR3 makes them 'the minimum or maximum length of records allowed for the fixed file attributes', and an existing file is held to them at OPEN (§2023:14.9.27.4 GR10, status 39 §2023:9.1.13.6 GR7). The implementor-defined extent of OPEN's validation belongs to the OPEN conflict rule's record. Same requirement.
